name: Tata Consumer Products Ltd
title: Tata Consumer Products Ltd - 500800 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 consolidated revenue +18% with EBITDA +27% and margin +100 bps to 14.6%; management guides 50–75 bps FY27 margin expansion and 30% growth-business growth, while flagging A&P stepping up to 7.5–8.5%.

utilisation.quote: Vietnam is now running at a 99% utilization

capex.quote: Board has also officially approved capacity expansion on tea extracts, which again, we're running out of capacity

triggers.label: Vietnam solubles utilisation 99%
triggers.quote: Vietnam is now running at a 99% utilization

triggers.label: Tea extract capacity expansion approved
triggers.quote: Board has also officially approved capacity expansion on tea extracts

triggers.label: Consolidated revenue +18% in Q4
triggers.quote: our consolidated revenue for the quarter grew 18%

triggers.label: Tea price cuts after input cost fall
triggers.quote: we've taken price cuts as we've seen tea costs go down

triggers.label: Working capital days 26 to 21
triggers.quote: Working capital was down now to 21 from 26 days last year

guidance.quote: 50 to 75, 80 bps is a given. I mean it's not an option. We will deliver it
top line, we will grow at double digits
for the growth businesses, and we will keep recalibrating as we go forward
directionally, we will be the 7.5% to 8.5% ratio as we go forward

guidance.value: mid-single-digit volume, mid to high single-digit top line
guidance.quote: we will target mid-single-digit growth and a couple of basis points of price mix

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are almost there, but not there in this quarter

red_flags.label: Market share data dropped from disclosure
red_flags.quote: Going forward, we will probably stop reporting this because we use them now only for execution and not for actual benchmarking

red_flags.label: Capital Foods below expectations post GTM relay
red_flags.quote: Capital Foods was a bit subdued. I would have loved for it to grow, but it still grew double digit

evasions.quote: Longer term, your guess is as good as mine.
I wouldn't compete about competitors with numbers and data, which I'm not too clued-in about.
